title: Interleaved canary and operator review for batching and caching recommendations
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Goal: Implement a staged, observable system to safely apply batching and KV-cache recommendations produced by the Optimize engine. The flow must combine short-lived canaries with an operator review step so we can auto-deploy low-risk changes while requiring human approval for higher-impact ones. This ticket scopes the control plane and runtime hooks needed to: 1) create ephemeral canary deployments that route a configurable percentage of traffic, 2) gather quality and cost signals, 3) evaluate automatic pass/fail thresholds, and 4) escalate to operator review when thresholds are uncertain or risk is high. The system must also support automatic rollback triggers and an OK-to-apply manual approval workflow with audit logging for Private/Dedicated customers.
acceptance_criteria: Can create a canary rollout for a single Optimize recommendation with traffic routing percentages configurable per-release
Dashboard shows per-canary metrics: token-cost delta, median/95th latency, error rate, sample-quality delta (BLEU/ROUGE or embedding-similarity), and request-side regressions
Auto-pass policy exists: canary auto-promotes when cost savings >= 8% AND latency delta <= +5ms AND quality regression <= 0.5% over 10k requests
Operator-review gate: recommendations flagged as high-impact (cost saving > 15% OR any latency increase > 10%) require a manual approval action recorded in the audit log
Automatic rollback runs within 30s of triggered rollback condition and documented in runbook
Unit/integration tests that simulate canary metrics and validate promotion/rollback logic
Works for both hosted and Dedicated deployments; Private flows require operator approval by default unless customer opts-in
design_notes: We will extend the rollout controller to understand two new recommendation metadata fields: estimated_cost_delta_pct and estimated_quality_risk_score. The controller spawns a short-lived canary cluster (same binary and model binary) using existing dedicated pool abstractions. Metric collection hooks attach to the per-route tracer and the Console ingestion pipeline. Evaluate quality using a small random sample + embedding-similarity baseline stored in Optimize's eval store. Decision engine is a simple ruleset today (configurable policies stored in the Console); long-term plan is to plug in a scoring ML policy. Audit events are emitted to the existing audit-log stream and surfaced in the Console UI. For Private deployments we add an RBAC check so only admin roles can perform the operator-approval action.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (dev): implement controller and local canary simulation with synthetic traffic. Phase 2 (staging): hook the metrics pipeline and run 50 internal canaries across diverse workloads. Phase 3 (beta-hosted): enable opt-in auto-promote for low-risk recommendations for 10 customers, gated by SLOs. Phase 4 (GA): default behavior for hosted; Dedicated retains opt-in; Private requires approval by default. Traffic percentages for canary: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 24h, with automatic promotion checks at each step. Manual operator review pauses the pipeline and surfaces a checklist (slo, quality sample, PR link).
test_plan: Unit tests for decision engine, e2e test that spins up a canary with a fake recommendation and synthetic traffic (latency/cost/quality knobs). Create chaos tests where the canary increases error rate to validate rollback. Add regression tests for audit event emission and RBAC enforcement. Add performance test to ensure controller scale: 200 concurrent canaries across Dedicated pools without control-plane OOM.
